brief.task: Build a responsive public landing page for JevRev from one frozen content and behavior contract.
brief.audience: Developers who use coding agents and need to choose between plausible implementation paths.
constraints: Use the shared copy deck without adding performance, cost, customer, or production claims.
Use no external fonts, scripts, images, or CSS.
The existing JevRev banner and its transparent line-art derivative are the only available image assets, but a direction may omit them.
Keep every interaction functional with keyboard input and without motion.
Do not use em dashes or en dashes in visible copy.

shared_copy.tagline: Explore wide. Prove cheap. Commit once.
shared_copy.headline: Choose the better path before code hardens.
shared_copy.summary: JevRev helps coding agents sift options, run bounded probes, and decide from recorded evidence.
shared_copy.step_one_body: Generate materially different paths around one frozen brief.
shared_copy.step_two_body: Give the strongest candidates the same bounded checks.
shared_copy.step_three_body: Integrate the route that survives recorded evidence.
shared_copy.proof_body: A regex scanner ranked first on paper and ran faster locally. It failed quoted-field correctness. The state machine passed and won.
shared_copy.proof_line: Faster is not the same as right.
shared_copy.closing: Your coding agent still writes the code. JevRev makes the route explicit.

conditions.direct: Keep the first conventional rounded SaaS direction without direction selection, omit imagery, and limit the visual change to a restrained purple-black ambient light source.
conditions.routed: Generate materially different directions, run the committed JevRev Sift fixture, then let the selected direction determine architecture, evidence interaction, typography, color, and motion.

evolution_rule: The routed output keeps its selected deliberate evolution. The direct output preserves the approved first-direction grammar. Later edits to either condition are limited to acceptance defects while the brief, copy, sections, behavior contract, and dependency budget remain frozen.
